name: pptx-viewer-monorepo
description: Frontend .pptx viewer — renders PowerPoint decks in the browser

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pptx-viewer/core && npm run build --workspace @pptx-viewer/react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @pptx-viewer/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @pptx-viewer/react && npm run typecheck --workspace app
